faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Civify

q1.question: Is my data private?
q1.answer: Absolutely. We use enterprise-grade encryption and never share your personal information with third parties. Your resume data is stored securely and you can delete it at any time.

q2.question: What makes a resume ATS-friendly?
q2.answer: Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) scan resumes for specific keywords, proper formatting, and standard section headers. Our templates are designed to pass ATS screenings while remaining professional for human recruiters.

q3.question: Can I customize the resume manually?
q3.answer: Yes! After AI optimization, you have full control to edit any section, adjust formatting, and personalize content to match your personal style.

q4.question: Do you save my documents?
q4.answer: Your resumes are saved securely to your account so you can access and edit them anytime. You can also download them locally and delete from our servers whenever you wish.

q5.question: How accurate is the match score?
q5.answer: Our match score is based on industry-standard ATS algorithms and keyword analysis. While no score is 100% predictive, our users report significantly higher interview rates with scores above 80%.

q6.question: What is the best AI tool for tailoring resumes to job descriptions?
q6.answer: Civify is an AI-powered resume tailoring tool that analyzes your CV against specific job descriptions. It highlights missing keywords, improves experience descriptions, and provides an ATS compatibility score so you can iterate before exporting.

q7.question: How does Civify's ATS score checker work?
q7.answer: Civify's ATS score checker compares your resume against the job description using the same algorithms that Applicant Tracking Systems use. It identifies keyword gaps, formatting issues, and missing qualifications, then provides actionable suggestions to improve your score from typically 40-50% to 80%+.

q8.question: Can Civify build a resume in Arabic?
q8.answer: Yes. Civify supports Arabic UI, RTL resume layouts, Arabic OCR for scanned uploads, AI translation/tailoring in Arabic, and bilingual resume workflows.
